name: Panic
overview: The Scriptures reveal that panic often arises in the context of warfare and divine judgment, as seen when God’s terror causes surrounding cities to refrain from pursuing His people (Genesis 35:5) and when fear and trembling overwhelm enemy nations (Exodus 15:14-16). This panic is not random but is a direct result of God's sovereign power against His foes, causing them to flee even when unpursued (Leviticus 26:17) and enabling the faithful to overcome overwhelming odds by His strength (Deuteronomy 32:30). Thus, panic is portrayed as a God-ordained instrument that secures His people’s deliverance and demonstrates His supreme authority over enemies.
